technology_name: AN AUTO-DIMMING SYSTEM FOR HEADLAMPS OF VEHICLES AND METHOD OF OPERATING THE SAME
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Automotive Lighting Controller / Smart Driver Assist
problem_solved: High-beam glare from oncoming vehicles temporarily blinds drivers on dark single-lane roads, which sharply spikes nighttime collision risk factors.
description: An intelligent automotive lighting control setup integrating a forward-facing optical sensing unit, an automated anti-glare dimming network, and a time-delay logic engine that intelligently triggers transitions between high-beam and low-beam headlight states.
applications: Adaptive automotive headlight systems, commercial transport driver assistance suites, night-vision safety equipment, and autonomous delivery vehicle lighting panels.
secondary_sector: Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
